verdict.rationale: Medusa is a commerce platform, so agent-facing product discoverability is a fair question to ask of it. The pack shows no cross-merchant catalog or agent feed. Its MCP server and llms.txt serve Medusa documentation, not merchant products. The Store API OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block for constructing such a feed, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my products are discoverable by AI agents and answer engines through a cross-merchant catalog or feed built for agents
